open_questions: Individual transit depths vary from -259 to 1558 ppm (sector 22, 23, 50); ground-based time series at this 13.8 d period can confirm whether all expected transits occur at consistent depth.
dossier.public_summary: TESS shows a shallow 500 ppm dip about every 14 days on this bright K dwarf with a flat-bottom shape implying about a 2 Earth-radius object. The few hints of odd-even and secondary dips are weak and inconsistent, and no nearby star can mimic it. Depth variations likely come from the star's 6-day spot variability, leaving a planet as the best explanation.

reasons.why: Undiluted 498.3 ppm depth implies 1.93 Rearth, below the 10 Rearth giant-planet threshold, favours planet over stellar eclipse despite secondary signal.
Flat-bottomed transit shape (ingress fraction 0.35, low V-significance) and low impact parameter fit b 0.4673 support planet rather than grazing EB.

Secondary is only 5.273 sigma and weaker than best brightening 7.541 sigma; SNR at half period -0.2037 shows no consistent binary secondary, and phase offset inconsistent with half-period EB, so not positive evidence for EB despite low xgboost score 0.15.
reasons.value: 5.273 at phase 0.6308 depth_ppm 141.2 (~0.2758 of dip, phase offset 0.1308, depth_over_bump 0.6992)

reasons.why: Odd/even depth difference 372.9 vs 635.3 ppm and 2.537 sigma is below 4 sigma binary threshold, with sector_oe_max_sigma 3.379, so no significant odd-even binary sign.
No star within one TESS pixel (21 arcsec) can cause the dip with plausible eclipse; closest that could is at 129.9 arcsec requiring 0.056 eclipse, inconsistent with observed pattern.

No large phase-curve swing; star shows spot variability (rotation_d 6.153, 3015 ppm amplitude) but variability_chi2_dof 0.7726 and no transit shape correlation, explaining variable noise without requiring EB.

Offsets, outliers and spot-induced systematics cause large depth/scatter, but alone never reason to reject. Combine with flat bottom, small size and lack of on-target secondary, planet is still best explanation; xgboost planet_rank 0.15 low because of systematics, not missed EB signal.
